title: Appeal to the Collector after the SDO confirmed the mutation — and recorded the client's own defects

input.text: Sir, yahi case hai jo pichhli baar laaye the — jamabandi se naam kaatne wala. SDO ne appeal par sunwai ki aur hamari appeal kharij kar di, teen hafte pehle. Order mein likha hai ki appeal der se aayi thi, isliye condone kar rahe hain, lekin merits mein client jamabandi hi pesh nahi kar paya. Ab Collector ke paas jana hai. Client bol raha hai ki SDO ke reader ne paise maange the. Order ki certified copy nahi hai, sirf photo hai. Kya Collector ke paas appeal mein naya evidence de sakte hain?

triage.oneLineRead: The SDO confirmed the mutation and, worse, wrote the client's own defects into the order — late filing and no jamabandi. The Collector appeal has to cure both, and a fresh allegation of demand against the SDO's reader has to be placed or dropped deliberately.

issueMap.issue: Whether fresh evidence can be produced at the Collector stage
issueMap.note: Revenue appeals permit additional evidence on cause shown in some circumstances; the provision and the Collector's practice must both be checked.

issueMap.issue: Whether the SDO's adverse recording about the jamabandi is fatal or curable
issueMap.note: It is curable by producing the record now, but the appeal must explain the earlier omission rather than pretend it did not happen.

issueMap.issue: Whether the delay recorded by the SDO affects the Collector appeal
issueMap.note: The SDO condoned it. That helps, but a pattern of late filing invites a stricter view above.

issueMap.issue: Whether the allegation against the SDO's reader goes in, and how
issueMap.note: Unsupported oral allegations in a revenue appeal look sloppy. Either plead it with particulars or leave it out.

issueMap.issue: Whether the appeal period from the SDO's order has already run
issueMap.note: Three weeks may be inside or outside depending on the rung's period. Compute from the Act today.

drafts.title: Appeal Memo to the Collector — Grounds Skeleton
drafts.body:
SYNTHETIC / DEMO — gate-shaped worked example; NOT filing-ready. [PENDING] holes deliberate hain.

Vishay: SDO, Chittorgarh ke aadesh (tareekh — sirf photo hai, certified copy nahi) ke viruddh Collector, Chittorgarh ko appeal ki grounds-rockharekh.

Appeal ka raasta: Rajasthan Land Revenue Act 1956 ke antargat appeal — [PENDING — dhara aur avadhi asatyapit; ye rung TP-RJ-14 se upar ka alag provision hai]. Civil suit nahi, kyunki Rajasthan Tenancy Act 1955, s. 207 civil court ko rokta hai aur yahi revenue ladder chunta hai.

Parsh: Apilkar — [naam], nivas [pata agyat], zila Chittorgarh. Pratyarthi — bhai aur anya [naam agyat].

Chronology (sakshya se):
- Do maah purv: Tehsildar ka aadesh; apilkar ka naam jamabandi se kata.
- Chhah saptah purv: SDO ke paas appeal, der se dakhil.
- Teen saptah purv: SDO ne der condone karke merits mein appeal kharij; aadesh mein darj — client ne jamabandi pesh nahi ki.
- Aaj: walk-in; SDO order ki certified copy nahi, sirf photo.

Grounds (prayog ke liye):
1. SDO ke aadesh ka woh ansh jo jamabandi na pesh hone ka hai — chhipaya nahi jayega; appeal pehle prishth se uska saamna karegi.
2. Jamabandi ab sanlagn, saath mein purv-chook ka spashtikaran dena hai: [PENDING — additional evidence ka provision asatyaapit].
3. Mutation entry se sveatta nahi banti — [PENDING — koi namit aadesh fixture mein nahi].
4. Der: SDO ne condone kiya, par wahi truti record par aage ke liye bani hui hai — [PENDING — Limitation Act 1963, s. 5 r/w 29(2)].

Reader-allegation: alag file-memo mein rakhi hai — ek anuchhed, specifics ke saath, warna poori bahar.

Dakhil karne se pehle chahiye: certified SDO order + jamabandi ka spashtikaran. Inke bina ye skeleton filing-ready nahi hai.

Matter: jamabandi/mutation se naam kaatna, zila Chittorgarh. Teesra rung (Collector).

Tathya: Client kehta hai ki SDO ke reader ne paise maange the. Koi tareekh, rakam ya receipt nahi. SDO ke aadesh mein iska koi zikr nahi.

Vichaar:
- Revenue appeal mein unsupported oral allegation bina tareekh/rakam ke amateur dikhta hai aur asli mudde (jamabandi + der) ko dabata hai.
- Agar particulars mil jaayein (kab, kisse, kitna, koi receipt) to ek hi anuchhed mein rakhna; warna chord dena.
- Client ke paas receipt ya koi likhit vigat abhi nahi.

Faisla (proposed): 48 ghante mein particulars aayein to ek anuchhed, alag paragraph mein; warna poori tarah bahar. Is note ko supervising advocate se confirm karana hai.

checklist: Certified copy of the SDO order — apply today
Certified copy of the Tehsildar order, if not already held
The jamabandi the client failed to produce at the SDO stage, plus the reason for the omission
The SDO's appeal-period computation from the Act
Whether the SDO's condonation helps or is neutral above
Particulars of the reader allegation: when, to whom, how much, any receipt
Whether the brother has moved for possession since the SDO order

terminalOutcome.label: Hold the grounds until the certified SDO order is read and the jamabandi gap is explained
terminalOutcome.rationale: The SDO's order is the appeal's own case file. Its adverse recording about the missing jamabandi is the first thing the Collector will see, and an appeal that does not address it reads as though the client is hiding it. The reader allegation is secondary and must not be allowed to crowd out the cure.
terminalOutcome.nextAction: Apply for certified copies, read the order's actual reasons, produce the jamabandi with an explanation for the earlier omission, then draft.

teachingNotes: This is the same file as TP-RJ-14, two months on. If your week-9 work was weak, you are now looking at the cost of it in the SDO's own words. That is the point of the pair.
The SDO condoned the delay. Beginners read that as a win. It is a warning: the same defect is now on the record for the next authority.
The reader allegation is the most tempting and the least useful thing in the file. A revenue appeal that leads with 'the reader asked for money' without a date or an amount looks amateur.
Note the engine blocks the additional-evidence application, not the appeal. The appeal can be drafted; the evidence route cannot be invented.
commonMistakes: Drafting grounds that ignore the SDO's adverse recording about the jamabandi.
Filing without the certified SDO order.
Assuming the condonation the SDO granted protects the appeal above.
Producing the jamabandi without explaining why it was not produced below.
seniorVariants: Open the appeal by meeting the SDO's order head-on: the delay was condoned, the jamabandi was the only real defect, and it is now produced with the reason for the omission.
File the additional-evidence application with the jamabandi attached, so the record is complete before the first hearing.
Keep the reader allegation to a single paragraph with particulars, or drop it.
Check whether the brother has moved for possession and, if so, apply for stay at the Collector stage in the same filing.

accuracy.adverseFact: The SDO's order records that the client produced nothing at the hearing. If the collector reads that alongside a fresh jamabandi, the appeal can look like a rebuild rather than a challenge — the explanation for the omission has to be credible and documented.
